blocks.html:
This method retrieves a shipping option type by its ID. It sends a request to the
[Get Shipping Option Type](https://docs.medusajs.com/api/admin#shipping-option-types\_getshippingoptiontypesid)
API route.

types.name: query
types.description: Configure the fields to retrieve in the shipping option type.

children.name: fields
children.description:
The fields and relations to retrieve separated by commas.

Learn more in the [API reference](https://docs.medusajs.com/api/store#select-fields-and-relations).

types.name: headers
types.description: Headers to pass in the request
